info.title: Wedding Website API
info.description: API for the wedding website - manage guests, events, RSVPs, gifts, photos, and more

get.description: Fetch all events with invite/RSVP counts (admin only)

post.description: Create a new wedding event. If isDefault is true, all guests are auto-invited (admin only)

get.description: Get a single event with RSVP counts (admin only)

patch.description: Update event details. Setting isDefault to true auto-invites all guests (admin only)

delete.description: Delete an event and cascade delete all invites (admin only)

get.description: Get all guests with their invite status for a specific event, including RSVP counts and email tracking

post.description: Create guest_event_invites records to invite guests to this event

delete.description: Delete guest_event_invites records to remove guests from this event

post.description: Send invitation emails to selected guests for this event, optionally using a Resend template

get.description: Get all gifts with guest info and totals (admin only)

patch.description: Update a gift record, e.g. mark thank-you email sent or link to guest (admin only)

get.description: Fetch all guests ordered by creation date (admin only)

post.description: Create a new guest, optionally with a plus-one, and send invitation email (admin only)

delete.description: Delete a guest by ID passed as query parameter (admin only)

get.description: Get a guest and their plus-one if they have one (admin only)

patch.description: Update a guest's details, manage plus-ones, and handle party reassignment (admin only)

post.description: Send wedding invitation emails to multiple guests at once using the default or a custom Resend template
Resend a wedding invitation email to a specific guest, with optional email override
Send an activities/things-to-do invitation email to a guest who has RSVP'd yes
Send a notification email to admin when a guest expresses interest in a hotel booking

get.description: Fetch all photos including inactive ones (admin only)

post.description: Add a new photo to the gallery (admin only)

patch.description: Update photo metadata such as alt text, description, display order, or active status

delete.description: Permanently delete a photo by its ID

get.description: Fetch all seating charts ordered by last updated

post.description: Create a new seating chart with a name, default seats per table, and optional notes

get.description: Fetch a seating chart with all its tables, guest assignments, and unassigned guests

patch.description: Update a seating chart's name, default seats per table, active status, or notes

delete.description: Permanently delete a seating chart and all its associated tables and assignments

post.description: Assign multiple guests to tables in a single operation, replacing any existing assignments

delete.description: Remove all guest-to-table assignments for a chart, or only specific guests via query params

post.description: Use OpenAI to generate intelligent seating assignments based on guest relationships, sides, and family groups
Create a new table in a seating chart with optional number, name, capacity, position, and shape

delete.description: Bulk delete all tables from a seating chart

patch.description: Update a table's number, name, capacity, position, shape, or notes

delete.description: Permanently delete a table and its guest assignments from the seating chart

get.description: Fetch all email templates from Resend

post.description: Create a new email template in Resend with optional variables and auto-publish

get.description: Fetch a specific email template by ID from Resend

patch.description: Update an existing email template's name, subject, or HTML content

delete.description: Permanently delete an email template from Resend

post.description: Create a copy of an existing email template in Resend
Publish a draft email template in Resend, making it available for sending
Submit an RSVP response for a specific event, confirming or declining attendance

get.description: Verify an invite code and check if the guest is invited to a specific event, returning guest and event details
Fetch all active photos for the public gallery

post.description: Submit an RSVP response for a guest party. Updates all guests with the given invite code

patch.description: Update guest contact information including mailing address, phone, WhatsApp, and preferred contact method

get.description: Verify an invite code and return associated guests

events.description: List of events with RSVP counts

partyId.description: Party ID to move guest to

family.description: Whether this is a family group

threeAndUnder.description: Whether the guest is 3 or under

partyId.description: Existing party ID to add guest to

guests.description: Guests associated with the invite code

is_plus_one.description: Whether this guest is a plus-one

primary_guest_id.description: ID of the primary guest if this is a plus-one

family.description: Whether this is a family group

three_and_under.description: Whether this guest is 3 or under
